Description:
# Additional Character Names
A mod for Owlcat's Rogue Trader cRPG. Adds additional random names for the RT and mercenaries in the character creator.

## Overview
This mod expands the available pool of randomly generated names in the character creator. By default, the game splits the available names into two pools: one for the player character and one for mercenaries, resulting in only 30 available names for each sex in each pool. This mod joins both pools together and then adds a slew of additional names taken from a list [provided by Fantasy Flight](https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/ffg_content/rogue-trader-col-ed/Official-RT-names.pdf) as supplemental material for the original tabletop RT. After removing duplicates and common/unsuitable/uninteresting entries, this results in around 300 names for males and 125 for females.

## Installation
This is an Owlmod, made using the Unity template supplied by Owlcat. Currently the game has a bug that prevents Owlmods from working. To fix this, you ***must*** install the Unity Mod Manager-based mod [MicroPatches](https://github.com/microsoftenator2022/MicroPatches/releases) by microsoftenator2022. You can install it manually or via [ModFinder](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146).

To install this mod, first make sure you have run the game at least once. Download the archive and extract it into:

%LocalAppData%Low\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\Modifications\
Each Owlmod needs to be in its own sub-folder in the Modifications folder.

Afterwards, you need to edit OwlcatModificationManagerSettings.json in the base Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader folder in a text editor (Notepad++ recommended). It should look something like this:

```
{
"$id": "1",
"SourceDirectories": [],
"EnabledModifications": ["DPAdditionalCharacterNames"],
"ActiveModifications": ["DPAdditionalCharacterNames"],
"DisabledModifications": []
}
```

If you have other mods, list them in quotes separated by commas. For example:

```
"EnabledModifications": ["DPAdditionalCharacterNames", "ModName2", "ModName3"],
"ActiveModifications": ["DPAdditionalCharacterNames", "ModName2", "ModName3"],
```

You can move individual mods from the ActiveModifications section to the DisabledModifications section if you want to disable them without physically removing them.

Alternatively, use [ModFinder](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146) to install the mod.

It should be fine to install the mod in an existing game at any point, although obviously it's primarily intended for new games.

## Known Issues
This mod replaces the vanilla localisation strings for player/merc character names. As such, it is not compatible with any other mod that also replaces the same strings. GUIDs: `62681797-7835-4b5c-b8dd-63918881b28a` / `d109f177-8a63-40eb-8a51-dcd29d3eb94e` / `29e96169-b891-43ef-8b01-bf821656e4d7` / `566bb5f9-4e93-448a-b654-b9c2f2dc3efb`.

Currently the mod only replaces the names for the English localisation. Other languages will continue to use the vanilla set of names. If anyone wants to contribute localised versions in another language, let me know.

## Acknowledgements
Many thanks to the modders on the Owlcat Dicord, but particularly microsoftenator2022 and Kurufinve.

Description:
#  Adepta Sororitas Sabbat-Pattern Helmets
A mod for Owlcat's Rogue Trader cRPG. Adds several Sabbat-pattern helmets for Argenta (or mod-added Sororitas background RTs) throughout the game.

***N.B.: As of patch 1.4.0.195, Owlcat have officially added the pre-release Sabbat-pattern helmet. Some consider this mod overpowered, so stick with the vanilla one if all you want is a fancy hat.***

## Overview
This mod adds the familiar Sabbat-pattern helmet employed by the Adepta Sororitas. Owlcat did initially showcase Argenta wearing one in the pre-release trailers, but for whatever reason this was removed and no longer exists in the game files. This is a new model made by me (although a hooded version uses one of Owlcat's hood models).

The mod contains four helmets. The first two - the standard base version and a hooded Celestian version - are available in chapters 2 and 4, respectively, via the Drusian vendor. The remaining two are paired with Argenta's mutually exclusive quest armours, available at the very end of chapter 4 at the conclusion of her quest. Additionally, this mod makes a minor tweak to the final cutscene/conversation of this quest to ensure that Argenta actually equips the armour and helmet she gains.

## Installation
This is an Owlmod, made using the Unity template supplied by Owlcat. Currently the game has a bug that prevents Owlmods from working. To fix this, you ***must*** install the Unity Mod Manager-based mod [MicroPatches](https://github.com/microsoftenator2022/MicroPatches/releases) by microsoftenator2022. You can install it manually or via [ModFinder](https://github.com/CasDragon/ModFinder/releases/latest).

To install this mod, first make sure you have run the game at least once. Download the [latest release](https://github.com/DarthParametric/RT_Adepta_Sororitas_Sabbat_Pattern_Helmets/releases/latest) or get it from [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/178) and extract it into:

%LocalAppData%Low\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\Modifications\
Each Owlmod needs to be in its own sub-folder in the Modifications folder.

Afterwards, you need to edit OwlcatModificationManagerSettings.json in the base Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader folder in a text editor (Notepad++ recommended). It should look something like this:

```
{
"$id": "1",
"SourceDirectories": [],
"EnabledModifications": ["DPAdeptaSororitasSabbatHelmet"],
"ActiveModifications": ["DPAdeptaSororitasSabbatHelmet"],
"DisabledModifications": []
}
```

If you have other mods, list them in quotes separated by commas. For example:

```
"EnabledModifications": ["DPAdeptaSororitasSabbatHelmet", "ModName2", "ModName3"],
"ActiveModifications": ["DPAdeptaSororitasSabbatHelmet", "ModName2", "ModName3"],
```

You can move individual mods from the ActiveModifications section to the DisabledModifications section if you want to disable them without physically removing them.

Alternatively, use [ModFinder](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146) to install the mod.

It should be fine to install the mod in an existing game at any point right up to completing Argenta's quest in chapter 4 (or after if you're willing to use Toybox to manually spawn the helmets).

## Known Issues
Additional localisation support has been added for non-English languages, but these have mostly been machine translated aside from those noted below. Expect errors and terrible/nonsensical grammar.

This mod creates a save dependency! You won't be able to load a save that used it if you later uninstall the mod.

With the engine version change in the v1.5 update, Owlcat broke the modding pipeline. This caused a few issues, amongst them custom body part assets being unloaded, resulting in characters turning invisible. See the [pinned comment](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/178?tab=posts) on the Nexus Mods page for a workaround if you are still using an older version of the mod.

The mod will be incompatible with any other mod that edits the CommandAction9 and CommandAction10 blueprints for the Argenta_Q2_ArgentaReturn_KTC cutscene. It's an unfortunate limitation of the way Owlmod blueprint patches work. It will probably also break (at least until I update it) if Owlcat patch those blueprints or otherwise alter the scene at some point to fix the vanilla bug.

## Acknowledgements
Many thanks to the modders on the Owlcat Dicord, but particularly microsoftenator2022 and Kurufinve, for helping to coach me through my ineptitude in order to get the mod working.

Description:
Thinking machines, or abominable intelligences, have long been banned in the Imperium. While machine spirits are able to fill many tasks for which such beasts were required, the act of processing, analyzing, and synthesizing large amounts of data is beyond the ability of a mere machine. To fill this role, humanity instead employs sages, individuals of great intellect trained to use their minds in powerful new ways which allow them to store vast amounts of data in compartmentalized segments and to use that data to make predictions and determinations which no lesser intelligence would be capable.

The Sage uses their superior intellect to predict the flow of events around them, staying a step ahead of their adversaries.

The Sage's active ability, Threat Analysis, lets them add their intelligence to their critical hit chance several times per combat.

The sage also has 5 talents available during level-up:
[list]
[*]Calculated Risk: dodge is based on intelligence rather than agility.
[*]Closed mind: the sage is immune to distracted and perplexed.
[*]Quick Thinking: The Sage adds their intelligence bonus to their initiative roll.
[*]Sound Arguments: The Sage may use their intelligence bonus in place of fellowship bonus.
[*]Supercomputing: Any time the Sage begins a turn with an Intelligence bonus of 10 or more, they gain +1 AP.
[/list]

Once the folder is there, you may need to edit your OwlcatModificationManagerSettings.json file. This is one level up from the mod's folder. It needs to look something like:

[code]﻿{"$id":"1","SourceDirectories":[],"EnabledModifications":["jhSage","BigFlagship","jhExpandedArchetypes"],"ActiveModifications":["jhSage","jhExpandedArchetypes"],"DisabledModifications":[]}
[/code]

# Allow Modded Achievements mod for Warhammer 40K: Rogue Trader

Separate mod to allow achievements while modded.

If you use Toy Box checkbox you don't need it.    

If you install both this and Toy Box, this mod applies regardless of Toy Box checkbox state.

## Installation
1. Unpack archive directly into `%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\UnityModManager\` WITHOUT creating additional archive named folder.
2. After running the game, navigate to UMM mod settings (press Ctrl-F10) and set settings as you need.

Resulting structure of already existing UnityModManager folder should be as follows
- `AllowModdedAchievements` (folder)
	- `AllowModdedAchievements.dll`
	- `Info.info`
	- `OwlcatModificationManifest.json`

## How to build (for developers only)
1. Set up RoguePath environment variable to point to game folder
2. Restore nuget packages
3. Clean Solution.
4. Build (note that on build output is automatically copied to installation path).

Name: Assassin Buffs
Author: Mawootad
About: Provides small buffs for the Assassin to make them scale better. Assassin as a class mostly has a clear and functional role but has numbers that are too low to fulfill the job of a pure damage dealer. This mod provides some small tweaks that improve how the Assassin's key abilities function.
Description:
Provides small buffs for the Assassin to make them scale better. Assassin as a class mostly has a clear and functional role but has numbers that are too low to fulfill the job of a pure damage dealer. This mod provides some small tweaks that improve how the Assassin's key abilities function:

[list]
[*]Openings: Are applied on extra turns. Damage cap 300 -> 200 + 2 x lethality.
[*]Killing Edge: Added damage is now base damage instead of non-scaling damage, benefiting from crit and other multipliers. Scaling lethality / 5 -> lethality / 10.
[*]Death Whisper: No longer reduces the damage dealt by openings
[/list]
In a later version, Assassin will be able to move after attacking. If you would like to add that functionality now you can add the Assassin_IntoTheShadows_Feature feature to your assassin via ToyBox.

[b]Installation:[/b]

You will need to install [url=https://github.com/microsoftenator2022/MicroPatches]MicroPatches[/url] [b]version 1.17.6+[/b] for this mod to work.

[/code]

Description:
[size=6][b][font=Tahoma]Overview[/font][/b][/size]
Lord Captains of the Koronus Expanse,

Ever thought to yourself, surely a figure as powerful, wealthy and influential as yourself should have a personal guard retinue? (Ignoring your companions... They aren't technically your guards...)

Well now you can have one!

These wardens are ready to follow you and die for you!

When you enter your void ship, depending on your net worth (Profit Factor) - a number of Wardens will be recruited automatically into your personal guard retinue, and when you enter any particular area, your guards will follow you and enter combat with you.

These guards all start as lowly conscripts, but can advance through the ranks from XP earned in combat by each guard.

If one of your guards dies... Well lets be honest, they're just cannon fodder, so *when* one of your guards dies, that guard is gone forever - along with their experience and title, and will be replaced when you return to the void ship.

Now you can feel like someone important and powerful with your guards surrounding you everywhere you go.

A fully persistent, evolving guard retinue system for Rogue Trader.

This mod will spawn in a number of Wardens to act as the Traders personal guards. They will follow the Trader, fight for the Trader, earn XP for fighting, earn new titles as they level up, and hopefully soon more behaviours will be added such as gear scaling with level, morale, warp influence, etc.

[b]----------------[/b]

[font=Tahoma][size=6]Installation[/size]
[size=4][b]Method 1: Using ModFinder[/b][/size]
Easiest method for installing any mods for Rogue Trader, head to this [url=https://github.com/CasDragon/ModFinder?tab=readme-ov-file#modfinder]GitHub[/url] ﻿link and download ModFinder, run the exe from the download, and drop the zip file over the section of ModFinder that says "Drag zips here to install", which should handle automatically installing the mod.

[/font][size=4][b]Method 2: Manual Installation[/b][/size]
1. Download this mod
2. Place the mod folder into [code]C:\Users\<your user here>\AppData\LocalLow\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\Modifications[/code]3. Open the file [code]C:\Users\<your user here>\AppData\LocalLow\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\OwlcatModificationManagerSettings.json[/code] in an editor such as a text editor or VS Code etc
4. Make sure "BodyGuard" has been added to the `EnabledModifications` and `ActiveModifications`. For example:
[code]{
"$id": "1",
"SourceDirectories": [],
"EnabledModifications": [
  "BodyGuard"
],
"ActiveModifications": [
  "BodyGuard"
],
"DisabledModifications": []
}[/code]
5. Profit

----------------

[font=Tahoma][size=6]Features[/size]
[size=5]Persistent Guard Roster[/size][/font]
Each guard has:
- A unique name inspired by WH40K lore
- A rank starting from Conscript through to Warden General
- Experience and level progression where experience is awarded based on the amount of damage done to enemies by the guard.
- Permanent death state - once your cannon fodder dies, they are replaced by a fresh new Conscript ready to absorb more bullets on your behalf.

[font=Tahoma][size=5]Experience and Leveling[/size][/font]
Guards gain experience dynamically based on their actions in combat:
- The guard will receive 1xp per 1 point of damage dealt to enemies.
- On taking damage and surviving, the guard will receive 0.5xp per point of damage received.
- When casting a buff, the guard will receive 5xp per AP cost of the buff
- On a kill of an enemy, the guard will receive XP in the amount of damage they dealt to the enemy. This includes kill assists - so if you killed an enemy that the guard damaged, the guard will get kill assist XP.
- The guard will also get an additional 50XP for surviving a combat.... Emphasis on surviving.

[size=5]Permanent Death[/size]
As per the Persistent Guard Roster, this is very much an XCOM inspiration... If... or rather... when, your guard dies, their experience and gear is gone for forever, and they are replaced with a new Conscript from the lower decks who has probably never even seen sunlight before...

[size=6][b]Important Notes
[/b][/size]----------------

[size=5]Increasing Guard Count
[/size]There now exists a vendor on the bridge of the Voidship, Lieutenant Varro Halen, who will allow you to spend Requisition Points to increase the number of guards you can have in your squad.

[size=5]Increasing Guard Base Rank
[/size]You can increase the base rank new guards are recruited at by visiting the vendor Lieutenant Varro Halen on the Voidship bridge, so if you increase the base rank to Private for example, then all new recruits will automatically be leveled up to level 2 and skip the Conscript rank, instead spawning in as a Private, and so on for all proceeding ranks.

[size=5]Requisition Points
[/size]Requisition points are earned by your guards for their actions taken in battle. These actions include damaging enemies, killing enemies, getting kill assists, surviving damage taken, and surviving a battle overall. You can check your current Requisition Point count by visiting the vendor Lieutenant Varro Halen on the Voidship bridge.

[size=5]Weapon Progression[/size]
Currently the guards receive a weapon based on their rank, where that weapon will be a type of Lasgun. The higher their rank, the better the Lasgun.

[b]Conscript[/b] - Scrappy Lasgun
[b]Private[/b] - Scrappy Lasgun
[b]Lance Corporal[/b] - Lasgun
[b]Corporal[/b] - Lasgun
[b]Master Corporal[/b] - Ghost Lasgun
[b]Sergeant[/b] - Ghost Lasgun
[b]Gunnery Sergeant[/b] - [Retobi Pattern] Hotshot Lasgun

[b]Warden General[/b] - Necrontech Hotshot Lasgun

[size=5]Guard Rank Progression
[/size]Guards increase in rank for every 2 levels, so a level 2 guard would be a Private, a level 4 guard a Lance Corporal, etc.

For an idea of level progression, a good reference is this XP table from GameSpot [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/ps5/369358-warhammer-40000-rogue-trader/faqs/82192/character-creation]here[/url]

[size=5]Unit Skin Progression[/size]
[size=2]Until I can figure out how to get different armour to appear on the Guardsmen when equipped since the Guardsmen models are baked for optimization by Owlcat, it's going to take a good amount of effort to work around it.. But for now, to give the appearance of progression, the guards receive more fancy looking skins when they reach certain ranks. Here's the progression:

[font=Tahoma][size=6][b]Planned Features[/b][/size][/font]
[size=5]Guard Vendor[/size]
Vendor on the Voidship bridge who allows you to purchase equipment upgrades for your guard retinue, and as a new means of increasing the number of guards in your retinue.

[size=5]Personnel History[/size]
Inspect a guard to see their history - what battles have they participated in, how many enemies have they killed, how long have they been alive, etc

[size=5]Guard Archetypes
[/size]At the moment the mod offers purely ranged guards with Lasguns, but the plan is for the Vendor to offer upgrades to allow you to change the archetype of a guard from ranged to melee, or to heavy weapons specialist, etc.

Suggestions, balance notes, and feature requests are welcome. This system is designed to grow over time, and community input helps shape its direction.

# EnhancedControls - mod for Warhammer 40000: Rogue Trader

Adds UX related stuff. 

If you're a user, downloads are on the right. See **Releases** link.
You can see detailed mod description on [Nexus page](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/14).


## How to build

1. Get the usual tools (Visual Studio and .NET development stuff)
2. Clone the repo
3. Build. And then Build again. Project looks up your RT installation dir from your game logs (so you need to run the game at least once).

That's it. On Build output is copied into UMM folder in appdata.


## How to contribute localization

After installing the mod localization files are in `Localization` folder.   
If you named mod install folder `EnhancedControls` then full path to them would be `%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\UnityModManager\EnhancedControls\Localization`

English localization is in `enGB.json`

Copy this file and rename new file according to the language you're translating into.
Russian  - `ruRU.json`    
German   - `deDE.json`   
French   - `frFR.json`   
Chinese  - `zhCN.json`    
Spanish  - `esES.json`   
Japanese - `jaJP.json`   

(If your system is set to hide file extensions and you don't see `.json`, then ignore that part)

Open your new localization file with any text editor - but for best results use something with syntax highlight - Notepad++, Visual Studio Code, or something else.   
Change **Text** properties to translate things.  
Start the game in chosen language to see the effect. Or switch the language in settings, the mod will reload your changes.

Send me translation file if you want me to include your translation with the mod.

Description:
Expanded Archetypes is a project to add new abilities and talents to the existing character class archetypes in Rogue Trader. The goal is to provide novelty, added variety, and more interesting build decisions.

The goal is to add abilities and talents to each of the original four tier 1 archetypes. I am trying to loosely theme these around the idea of trees, related features that build out a clear but missing niche for those paths. I am focused on tier 1 as I feel that is where broader choices belong while tier 2 is intended for specialization.

The Soldier gets a shotgun tree and heavy weapons talents.
[list]
[*]The Pistol Whip ability lets a ranged weapon-equipped soldier mix in some melee up close with the ability to stun the target.

[*]The Gut Shot talent makes shotgun attacks on adjacent targets automatically hit.
[*]Big Guns adds 10 armor when wielding a heavy weapon.
[*]Suppressing Fire slows targets hit by heavy weapons.
[/list]
The Operative gets a sneaky tree and a broader foundation to build on:
[list]
[*]The Disengage ability lets the operative safely extract themselves from melee and lower their target priority
[*]The Backstab talent increases damage while the Operative is the lowest priority target
[*]The Marked Target talent leaves one exploit intact when abilities would otherwise remove them all
[*]The Vanish talent expands the Perfect Spot ability by making the operative the lowest priority target when Perfect Spot is used
[*]No Scope reduces the cost of deadeye shots.
[*]Additional attributes and skills added to level-up to allow for more diverse characters.
[/list]
The Officer gets a heroic self-buff tree.
[list]
[*]Deeds Not Words is an ability that gives a full stat buff based on Fellowship.
[*]The Shield of Courage talent is a Deeds upgrade that adds armor to the buff
[*]The Guide My Hand talent is another Deeds buff that makes attacks automatically hit.
[*]The Audacity talent lets the officer substitute Fellowship for Agility in calculating Dodge.
[/list]
The Warrior gets a flamer tree and two-handed weapon talents.
[list]
[*]Fuel for the Fire is an ability that triggers instances of burning on nearby targets.
[*]Pyromaniac is a talent that refunds 1 ap the first time a flame or melta weapon is used in a turn.
[*]Conflagration is a talent that adds stracks of burning based on ballistic skill.
[*]Enveloping Flames is a talent that increases the minimum damage of flame and melta weapons based on ballistic skill.
[*]Cleave Through does damage to an adjacent opponent following a kill while wielding a two-handed melee weapon.
[*]Overhead Smash increases armor penetration while wielding a two-handed melee weapon.
[/list]

You may need to respec to see changes.

This is still a work in progress.Feel free to use the comments to suggest more additions to archetypes in the future.

A rather niche fix in the grand scheme of things that I made mostly for myself, but I thought someone out there might find useful. It happens to be my first & probably? only mod I'll ever publish. Hopefully someone else will get a use out of it!

Update 12/24/24:
1.) I realized the version # I listed on the Nexus (1.4) was apparently mismatched w/ the "real"/functional version # (1.0.4). I attempted to update the Nexus listing to correct the error. Given that I'm rather inexperienced w/ all of this, I'm not fully sure when/if this will be reflected in Modfinder and/or if this will result in some weird "ghost versions" lingering about in the Nexus systems. Anyway, there were no actual changes to the mod itself, just an update to the proper version # in the Nexus listing.

2. According to their patch notes, Owlcat fixed the Toxic Flamer's #2 attack in patch 1.3.0.47 , but I couldn't find any mention of changes for the other 2 flamers this mod affects. As such, this appears to be redundant if you only wanted the fix for the Toxic Flamer, but is probably? still needed for the other 2. I say probably bc I've not really tested the mod in any way post-patch other than booting the game up & checking the character screen (I'm waiting for the DLC to push through another full playthrough). Anyway, the character screen says the AP reduction is still functioning & I didn't see any observable issues w/ the affected flamers from there, so AFAIK it still appears to be functioning more or less as it was pre-patch.

# Kibellah Hairstyle Switch A mod for Owlcat's Rogue Trader cRPG. Adds an option to swap the bowl cut for something less terrible. ## Overview This mod adds a selection of alternative hairstyles for everyone's favourite goth girlfriend. Inspired by a Reddit meme by [TequilaBaugette51](https://old.reddit.com/r/RogueTraderCRPG/comments/1p43nbf/all_that_cutting_and_kibellah_cant_get_a_decent), reproduced here:

## Installation This is an Owlmod, made using the Unity template supplied by Owlcat. In order to properly load custom assets, you ***must*** install the Unity Mod Manager-based mod [MicroPatches](https://github.com/microsoftenator2022/MicroPatches/releases) by microsoftenator2022. You can install it manually or via [ModFinder RT](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146). Use [ModFinder RT](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146) to install this mod automagically. Alternatively, to install the mod manually, first make sure you have run the game at least once. Download the mod from the [releases section](https://github.com/DarthParametric/RT_Kibellah_Hairstyle_Switch/releases/latest) or [Nexus](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/407) and extract it into: `%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\Modifications\` Each Owlmod needs to be in its own sub-folder in the Modifications folder. Afterwards, you need to edit OwlcatModificationManagerSettings.json in the base Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader folder in a text editor (Notepad++ recommended). It should look something like this: ``` { "$id": "1", "SourceDirectories": [], "EnabledModifications": ["DPKibblesHairSwitch"], "ActiveModifications": ["DPKibblesHairSwitch"], "DisabledModifications": [] } ``` If you have other mods, list them in quotes separated by commas. For example: ``` "EnabledModifications": ["DPKibblesHairSwitch", "ModName2", "ModName3"], "ActiveModifications": ["DPKibblesHairSwitch", "ModName2", "ModName3"], ``` You can move individual mods from the ActiveModifications section to the DisabledModifications section if you want to disable them without physically removing them. ## User Settings You can configure the mod's settings via the [Owlcat Mod Manager](img/OMM_Settings.jpg) (Shift-F10 by default). Click on the Settings button next to the mod's name in the list, which will open its settings page. Alternatively, you can also open the [DLC and Mods Manager](img/DLC_Manager_Settings.jpg) on the lefthand side of the main menu, switch to the Mods tab, and scroll down until you find the mod's entry. There you can click on the Settings icon to open the mod's settings window directly. Once the settings page is open, you can pick which of the available hairstyles you want to swap to. Click the Apply button after making your choice to save the setting. Note that if you change the hair while playing you will need to exit to the main menu and reload or restart the game for the change to apply. Your settings will be saved in a `DPKibblesHairSwitch_Data.json` file in the Modifications folder. The settings apply universally across all saves. ## Known Issues The mod works when using a controller, but the in-game settings window is not available for the controller layout. Machine translations for the config screen text have been added. If anyone is willing to provide proper translations, let me know. ## Acknowledgements Many thanks to the modders on the Owlcat Discord, but particularly microsoftenator2022, Kurufinve, and ADDB for helping to coach me through my ineptitude in order to get the mod working. Thanks to Kurufinve for providing improvements to the Russian translation.

Lives are spent freely on the battlefields of the Imperium, but they are not wasted. A soldier who can take back up their lasgun is more valuable than one bleeding out in the mud. Tending to survivable injuries and relieving those whose wounds are not is the task of the Medicae. These driven battlefield chiurgeons carry an array of wound treatments and combat drugs which have returning soldiers to the line as their only purpose - long term outcomes are beyond their charge.

The medicae is a new tier 1 archetype for rogue traders and companions. It includes entirely new active abilities and talents and introduces a new team role to the party as well as the ability to bring back fallen teammates during combat and an attempt at bringing a pet mechanic into the game (pre-Lex).

The medicae has the following active abilities:

[list]
[*][b]Battlefield Medicine[/b] - The medicae heals an adjacent ally for (Medicae/4)+(Medicae/10) wounds. This ability also removes bleeding, burning, and toxin, and clears one fresh injury.
[*][b]Resuscitate[/b] - An adjacent downed ally is brought back to action with 10% of their maximum wounds.
[*][b]Apothecarion Servoskull[/b] - This servoskull may heal any ally within 6 cells for (Medicae/4)+(Tech Use/10) wounds.
[*][b]To the Rescue[/b] - The medicae can move up to 3 + resolve cells. Ends movement for the turn.
[*][b]Medevac[/b] - An ally up to 6 cells away moves to the closest adjacent cell.
[*][b]Combat Drugs[/b] - This ability adds 20% of the medicae's medicae skill to the target's Strength, Toughness, and Agility for 2 turns.
[*][b]The Emporer's Peace[/b] - The medicae can deal fatal damage to an adjacent incapacitated enemy (One who is stunned or can't act).
[/list]
The medicae's momentum ability is Triage:[list]
[*][b]Triage[/b] - This ability heals all allies 50% of their maximum wounds.
[*][b]Triage[/b] (Desperate) - This ability heals all allies 50% of their maximum wounds but deals 50% of the medicae's wounds to themself.
[*][b]Triage (Upgrade 1)[/b] - All allies are instead healed to full wounds.
[*][b]Triage (Upgrade 2)[/b] - Allies targeted by Triage are immune to fatal wounds for one turn.
[*][b]Triage (Upgrade 3)[/b] - Triage also removes burning, bleeding, and toxin from allies.
[*][b]Triage (Upgrade 4)[/b] - Triage adds a 10% boost to the medicae's medicae skill for the rest of the combat.
[/list]
The medicae's talents:[list]
[*][b]Well-Stocked[/b] - The medicae has 50% chance to not use a charge when using a medikit.
[*][b]Diagnosticar[/b] - Battlefield Medicine heals an additional 5% per dot on the target.
[*][b]Anatomist[/b] - The medicae gains a medicae skill/5 bonus to critical hit chance with chain weapons and needle weapons.
[*][b]Amputate[/b] - Melee hits with chain weapons cause carouse/15 levels of bleeding to the target.
[*][b]Bonesaw[/b] - The damage bonus with chain weapons is based on carouse skill instead of strength.
[*][b]Precocious Servoskull[/b] - The Apothecarion Servoskull can be used on allies up to 10 cells away.
[*][b]Stay Low[/b] - Using To the Rescue makes the medicae the lowest priority target for one turn.
[*][b]Reanimator[/b] - The target of Resuscitate gains an additional 10% of the medicae's medicae skill wounds.
[*][b]Overmedicate[/b] - The target of Battlefield Medicine gains the medicae's medicae skill/10 temporary wounds in addition to normal healing.
[*][b]Innoculate[/b] - The target of Combat Drugs gains +10 to all resistances for 2 rounds.
[*][b]Chiurgeon[/b] - Battlefield Medicine has a chance to clear one trauma on the target.
[*][b]Bad Medicine[/b] - Successful attacks with needle weapons add additional toxin stacks equal to 10% of the medicae's medicae skill.
[*][b]Synskin Grafter[/b]- When the medicae uses Battlefield Medicine on an ally, that ally gains 5% armor for the remainder of combat..
[*][b]First Responder[/b] - The medicae adds their perception bonus to initiative rolls.
[*][b]Help is on the Way[/b] - Using To the Rescue does not provoke attacks of opportunity from adjacent opponents.
[*][b]Now or Never[/b] - The medicae's medicae skill is increased by 10% when momentum is below 50.
[*][b]Combat Veteran[/b] - Increase the medicae's resolve by the number of medicae abilities known.
[/list]
The medicae can select assassin, executioner, master tactician, or overseer in tier 2.


[b]Installation:[/b]

You will need to install [url=https://github.com/microsoftenator2022/MicroPatches]MicroPatches[/url] [b]version 1.17.6+[/b] for this mod to work.

The easiest way to install it would be to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146]Modfinder[/url]﻿. Download the .zip file and drag it into the Modfinder window or select it from the list.

Once the folder is there, you may need to edit your OwlcatModificationManagerSettings.json file. This is one level up from the mod's folder. It needs to look something like:

[code]﻿{"$id":"1","SourceDirectories":[],"EnabledModifications":["jhMedicae"],"ActiveModifications":["jhMedicae"],"DisabledModifications":[]}
[/code]

Description:
The Operative is currently significantly weaker than other T1 archetypes, this mod significantly buffs Operative's abilities and makes the behavior flow together better. The new Operative leans heavily into debuffing support paired with very high single target damage. Their exploits are no longer consumed on hit and provide a team-wide damage boost but their overall damage boost for the Operative is generally lower, but their real damage output now comes from Expose Weakness. Expose Weakness keeps the team-wide damage boosts from exploits for the turn it's active in addition to stripping armor, dodge, parry, and block while massively boosting the damage of the Operative's next attack plus granting additional boosts according to the number of stacks removed. Along with general improvements to weaker abilities and talents this should help reinforce the Operative's strengths as a single-target damage specialist and debuffer while still retaining their defined weaknesses of limited mobility and multi-target damage.

Note that this is currently in a beta state; there may be bugs or weird balancing.

Installation Instructions:
[list]
[*]Download ModFinder ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146]https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146[/url]﻿)
[*]Open ModFinder
[*]Drag the mod zip file into ModFinder
[*]Mod is now installed. You may need to close and reopen Rogue Trader to see any changes.
[/list]
Overall changelist is as follows:
[list]
[*]Exploit: No longer removed on hit. Stacks increase all damage taken by 5%, including for damage over time and from allies. The operative deals +5 + PER% per stack instead. Exploits from multiple Operatives stack, however Operatives only gain bonus damage for their own stacks and cannot remove stacks from other Operatives.
[*]Expose Weakness: Now increases damage by 5% per stack, debuff scaling changed to a flat -5% armor, parry, block, and dodge. Casts of Expose Weakness now stack between uses by the same Operative, although duration is not increased by subsequent casts. After using Expose Weakness, the Operative's next attack vs the target deals an additional +(10 + stacks) x PER% damage and provides further boosts based on the number of weaknesses on the target:
[list]
[*]3+ stacks: The attack auto-hits
[*]6+ stacks: The attack auto-crits and ignores deflection
[*]10+ stacks: The operative regains 2 AP and can make an extra attack this turn
[/list][/list][list]
[*]Joint Analysis: No longer removes exploits, instead adds an exploit when allies hit an enemy, but limited to one proc per enemy per turn.
[*]Precise Attack: No longer requires exploits to work. Scaling 15 + 3 * exploits% -> 10 + 2 * PER%. Now also reduces dodge. Now additionally applies 2 exploits.
[*]Informed Hit: Critical hits with Precise Attack apply an additional stack of exploit. Auto-crit threshold 10 - INT -> 6 - INT/2.
[*]Insightful Precision: Scaling changed to flat +5 perception when using Precise Attack
[*]Intimidation: Scaling 5 + PER/2% -> 15 + PER%, but no longer doubles vs low armor. Also reduces MP by 3.
[*]Terrifying Presence: Killing a target with Intimidation now also extends the range to LoS.
[*]Perfect Spot: Applies exploits to all enemies in LoS at the start of the Operative's turn.
[*]Tactical Knowledge: No longer removes all stacks when cast vs a single target. Armor scaling 1% -> 1 + INT/5%. Damage scaling 2% -> 2 + INT/2%. Stacks between multiple casts.
[*]Improved Tactics: New effect, adds a stack of Tactical Knowledge at the start of combat and grants +1 additional stacks when using Tactical Knowledge.
[*]Dismantling Attack: Applies 6 stacks of Exploit Weakness instead of applying a -30% penalty to armor, dodge, parry, and block and gains the first hit damage bonus of Exploit Weakness. Dismantling Attack also makes Exploit Weakness no longer expire from the target.
[*]Comprehensive Analysis: New effect, analyze enemy distributes half the stacks of exploit on enemies within 5 tiles. If there are no enemies within 5 tiles those exploits are placed on the main target.
[*]Continuous Analysis: New effect, applies exploits on combat start and on extra turns in addition to at the start of normal turns.
[*]Inflict Despair: Triggers if enemy has exploit and expose weakness -> triggers if enemy has expose weakness.
[*]Joint Offense: Scaling INT/2% -> 2 + INT/2%
[*]Passive Learning: New effect, grants +1 intelligence when an enemy with an exploit dies.
[*]Reactive Study: Doesn't require an exploit to proc (not a change in behavior, in-game tooltip doesn't reflect actual behavior)
[*]Sharpshooter: Scaling every 5 tiles -> every 4 tiles. Works only on single shots -> works on all attacks, but only on the first attack of bursts.
[*]Tide of Excellence: Gains stacks when hitting a target with an exploit -> gains stacks when removing exploits or killing a target with an exploit.
[*]Aeldari Ranger Sight: Doesn't inflict permanent expose weakness, extends the duration of expose weakness by 1 round.
[*]Omnissiah's Providence: Inflict 1 exploit and expose weakness after attacking -> cast exploit weakness on targets before attacking
[/list]
Source can be found at [url=https://github.com/Mawootad/OperativeRework]https://github.com/Mawootad/OperativeRework[/url]

Description:
# Player Gender Override (WH40K: Rogue Trader)

While the base game allows you to set your character's voice independently of 
their body type, your character's gender is determined based on your chosen
body type (I = male, II = female).
With this mod, you can override this behaviour.

![image](https://github.com/microsoftenator2022/PlayerGenderOverride/assets/105488202/20c39903-0045-4c12-bf2a-c59ad21402ee)

When active, the game will treat your character as the chosen gender. This
affects:
- Dialogue text (titles, pronouns, etc.)
- Spoken audio (as above)
- Gender-locked quests (romance). These may break if you change gender mid-quest.

Unlike changing your character's gender with eg. Toybox, this does not affect
animations or character model, so those will not break.

In addition, when active, you may optionally override each individual term
(text only).

![image](https://github.com/microsoftenator2022/PlayerGenderOverride/assets/105488202/670905c4-612b-435d-b4e9-be2b7532a916)

All settings are per-save, but this mod should not create a save dependency.

[b][color=#cccccc][size=5] ﻿[/size][/color][size=5]NEW DISCIPLINES[/size][/b]

[color=#cfe2f3]
[/color][b][color=#1e84cc][size=4]TELEKINESIS [/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]- [[/i][/size][/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]complete[/i][/size][/color][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i], [/i][/size][/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2]missing a couple of talents[/size][/color][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]][/i][/size][/color]

[quote]"Telekines wield raw psychic force, manipulating the physical world with their minds.
They can create invisible shields, hurl enemies or crush armor with their sheer will."[/quote][/b]
The Telekinesis discipline does everything a good telekinetic should do: crowd control, push, pull, with a little treat for single-shot and impact weapons.

[list]
[*][b]Assail[/b] - the original Assail from the beta, restored. Ranged AoE damage with the Prone CC
[*][b]Telekinetic Shield[/b] - restored; armor against ranged attacks
[*][b]Grasp[/b] - a new skill with an area grab
[*][b]Force Push[/b] - a new skill that will push away nearby characters, dealing damage
[*][b]Gate to Infinity[/b] - a long-range teleport with a cooldown
[*][b]Void Rend[/b] - a single-target damage skill with a chance of executing the target 
[/list]
Talents
[list]
[*][b]Gravitational Mastery[/b] - the psyker's allies are immune to Grasp and Force Push
[/list][list]
[*][b]Concussion[/b] - Impact damages dealt by the psykers have a chance of inflict stun
[*][b]Apply Force [/b]- The first single-shot attack used by the psyker every turn gains extra WP damage and the target suffer -20 dodge chance.
The psyker can use either Willpower or Agility for the Demolition skills, and either Willpower or Strength for the Athletic skills, whichever is higher.[*][b]Reality Ward[/b] - Targets of the Telekinetic Shield ability are immune to the Prone condition and gain +(1+PsyRating) deflection against ranged attacks.
[*][b]Platesunderer [/b]- Extra armorpen to impact damages
[*][b]Grasp Extensia[/b] - Extra range for the [Grasp] Ability
[/list]
[b]Features Roadmap[/b][list]
[*]Full list of 6 Abilities ✔
[*]Available for Mercenaries ✔(?)
[*]Available for Unsanctioned Psykers ✔
[*]Available for Heinrix ✔
[*]Exemplar Psychic Awakening Talent ✔
[*]Full List of 8 Talents ✘ [i]6/8[/i]
[/list]
[b][color=#ffd966][size=4]ELECTROMANCY[b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]- [[/i][/size][/color][/b][/size][/color][/b][color=#ffd966][size=4][color=#f4f4f4][size=2]complete[/size][/color][/size][/color][b][color=#ffd966][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]][/i][/size][/color][/b][/size][/color]

[quote]"Whether channeling the deadly storms that shake the Warp or generating bio-lightning from their nervous system, Electromancers are forces to be feared on any battlefield.[/quote][/b]
The Electromancy discipline revolves around Shock damage, the Blinded status, and a custom debuff called Static Charge.

[list]
[*][b]Psybolt[/b] -  [i]The psyker summons a lightning from the Empyrean, dealing Shock damage. If the target have stacks of Static Charge this spell hit that many times instead, then all the stacks of Static Charge are removed.[/i]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Warp Storm[/b] - A storm that slow, applies Static Charges and deals damage to the units inside. 3 turns duration.
[*][b]Blinding Light[/b]- Blind ad applies Static Charges to enemies in range
[*][b]Electrokinetic Lash[/b] - a long-range damaging ray [[i]rework incoming[/i]]
[*][b]Chain Lightning[/b] -[i] [/i]Chains up multiple targets, dealing damage and spreading based on the Static Charges on them
[*][b]Neural Surge[/b] - [i]T[/i][i]he psyker deals WP Bonus Shock damage to the target ally. At the start of each turn, the damaged ally gains movement points equal to [/i]
[i]their Toughness bonus. The target's melee attacks apply Static Charge[/i][/list]Talents
[list]
[*][b]Thunderstruck[/b] -  [i]Enemies that begin their turn stunned, blinded or with Static Charge stacks within the psyker's line of sight take WP bonus Shock damage[/i].
[*][b]Neural Shield[/b] - [i]The psyker gains +(8 + 8*PsyRating)% additional armour against Shock damage and half this amount as additional armour against energy damage from Exotic and Power weapons.[/i]
[*][b]Stormcaller [/b]- Extra damage based on the Shock damage istances dealt this combat
[*][b]Warpstride[/b] - agility to allies under the effects of psychic powers
[*][b]Battle Sorcerer[/b] - [i]If the psyker's only equipped weapon is a one-handed, non-staff melee weapon, the first time each turn the psyker use a damaging psyker power they can make an extra melee attack with a -15 WeaponSkill malus.[/i] (This Talent will know if you are hiding a Bolter in your secondary weapon slots! You will get the extra melee attack only if the Melee Weapon is the only weapon on your character. Try use it with the talent [Sword and Sorcery] (this mod, psyker talents) - you can wield a sword/mace/axe in a hand and a Staff in the other hand, Gandalf/Eisenhorn style)
[*][b]Before The Storm[/b] - At the start of combat, inflicts Static Charge ranks to enemies.
[/list]
Buff/Debuff[b]
[/b][list]
[*][b]Static Charge -[/b] Max 5 stacks, -3AGI for each stack
[/list][b]Features Roadmap[/b][list]

[/list]

[b][color=#ff00ff][size=4]EXCESS[/size][/color] [b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]- [[/i][/size][/color][/b][/b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2]complete[/size][/color][b][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]][/i][/size][/color][/b][/b][b]

[quote]"Excruciating pain. Paralyzing pleasures. Consuming greed, pride, and self-indulgence. Using the warp to bend the body and mind of one's enemies is an unsanctioned practice, for it invites the influence of Chaos into the soul".[/quote][/b]
The Excess discipline is ispired by Slaneesh's domains. It revolves around CC and debuff. It's available to Sanctioned Psykers, but [u]not as a starting discipline[/u].

[list]
[*][b]Pangs of Misery[/b] -  Deals damage based on WP. Inflict a random physical or psychological trauma to the target after a save check
[/list][list]
[*][b]Allure [/b]-  [i]All enemies that are not immobilized in a 6-cell radius around the Psyker must pass a WP resistance test or immediately move 3 cells toward the character. For 1 round the psyker becomes the lowest priority target for enemy attacks.[/i]
[*][b]Sensory Overload[/b] - stun a target, transforming it in a full cover and dealing damage when the debuff wears off
[*][b]The Six Blades of Prosepheron[/b] - [i]This ability can only be used with at least one sword equipped, once per combat. Until the end of combat, the psyker can make +(Heretic Ranks) extra melee attacks during their turn.[/i]
[*][i][b]Tainted Shriek [/b]- [/i]single-target warp damage for your noise marine cosplayer
[*][i][b]Summon: Daemonette[/b] - [/i]summons a controllable Daemonette
[/list]Talents
[list]
[*][b]Sadistic Glee[/b] -  [i]Whenever the psyker deals damage to an ally, the psyker gains +1 Resolve until the end of their turn[/i].
[*][b]The Great Enemy[/b] - Whenever the psyker deals damage to an Eldar or Drukari character, they deals (PsyRating) to (PsyRating x HereticRanks) extra damage.
[*][b]Quest for Perfection [/b]- Keep track of your highest damage ever and earn Momentum when you break your record
[*][b]Blade Trance[/b] - The first use of a Combat Drug each turn cost 0AP. Until the start of the psyker's next turn, they get (3 x Heretic Rank) Perception and each melee attack use Perception instead of Strength when calculating bonus damage
[*][b]Soul Drinker[/b] - lifegain based on Perception when using Force Sword
[*][b]Delightful Agonies[/b] - 2xPerception chance to avoid some types of damage
[/list]
[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]FATE[/size][/color][color=#6d9eeb] [/color][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]- [/i][/size][/color][/b][/b][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i] [[/i][/size][/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]complete[/i][/size][/color][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i], [/i][/size][/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2]missing a couple of talents[/size][/color][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=2][i]][/i][/size][/color][/b][b]

[quote]"Knowledge is taint. Change is heresy. Weaving the fates of enemies and allies alike is an unsanctioned practice, for it draws the attention of the Architect of Fate."[/quote][/b]
The Fate discipline is ispired by Tzeentch's domains. It revolves around Warp damage and Veil Degradation. It's available to Sanctioned Psykers, but [u]not as a starting discipline[/u].

[list]
[*][b]Bolt of Change[/b] -  single-target fire and warp damage
[/list][list]
[*][b][/b][b]Baleful Ghost[/b] -  a decoy that take aggro for you
[*][b]Twisting Path[/b] - confuse you enemies
[*][b]Winds of Change [/b]-[i] [/i]a cone of fire damage that gains armorpen based upon veil degradation
[*][i][b]Pierce the Veil [/b]- [/i]once per fight, increse the Veil degradation to cast an additional spell
[*][i][b]Flickering Warpfire[/b] - [/i]AoE warp damage[i] with...extra effects[/i]
[/list]Talents
[list]
[*][b][/b][b]Harness the Winds of Magic[/b] - +1 Psy Rating when Veil Degradation is 20
[*][b]Radical studies[/b] - using Intelligente instead of Willpower for Spells and Talents
[*][b]Lore of Magic [/b]- +5 WP and INT for each Psyker Disciplines learned
[*][b]Mask of Deceit [/b]- huge Persuasion and small Dodge bonus based upon veil degradation
[*][b]Enneadic Ritual [/b]- temporary Psy Rating and stat bonus every 9th casted spell

[b][color=#cccccc][size=5] ﻿[/size][/color][size=5]TOOLS FOR PSYKERS[/size][/b]
[size=3]Items, Talent and events for Psyker characters[/size][size=2]
[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Sword and Sorcery[/b] - a new talent for every psyker; can wield staves one-handed if the other weapon isn't a shield, staff or ranged weapon.

You will be rewarded with Heretic Convinction Points, unique Feats, chains of events or something far worse if you fail the skill check. [spoiler]

[*]Voidfrost

[*]Staves?

[/list]


[b][color=#00ff00][b]FAQ, ISSUES and ﻿[/b][/color][b][color=#00ff00]FIXES:[/color]
﻿- I can't see Excess discipline when creating a new character | [/b][/b]That's intended, Santioned Psykers can't start with a radical (heretical?) discipline
[b][b] ﻿- I can't see some text | [/b][/b]If you're playing in english after Lex Imperialis, try deleting and reinstalling the mod. If you are playing in another language, open a Bug post with the missing text, the dlc wiped the localizations and maybe I skipped some parts.
[b] ﻿- Electromancy is too weak | [/b]It is? I'm bad at building. Try building up some Statik ranks with [Blinding Light] and [Before the Storm]. We are balancing it as a team in the comment section, if you have some advices I'll listen
[b][b][b][b] ﻿- [Talent/Skill/Build] is underpowered/overpowered and needs [something] | [/b][/b][/b][/b]As I said, I'm not a pro builder - but maybe you are! Tell me your opinion, if it makes sense it will be implemented
[b][b] ﻿- [Battle Sorcerer] from Electromancy doesn't work | [/b][/b]It's a problematic Talent, but it does work the majority of times. If you found a new bug let me know in the Bugs section.[b][b]
[b][b] ﻿- Can you do a [something] Discipline? | [/b][/b][/b][/b]I’d really love that.Disciplines take a huge amount of time and energy to implement, between visual effects and ideas — that's six skills and eight talents to design and develop. Leave a comment with your idea, it might be so complete or interesting that it becomes a priority.[b][b][b][b]
[/b][/b][b][b][b][b] ﻿- How can I trigger the Excess Quest? |[/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b] After reading the Tome of Excess, selecting Lust and winning the skill check, you will gain a Talent. The second part of the quest will trigger in the same way after reaching Heretical2 and warping around. The event is set at low priority, meaning that [u]Green Routes[/u] are more likely to trigger it. 





Feel free to use the comments section to suggest additional Talents and report bugs. Your opinion and ideas on balancing and internal changes is extremely
valuable.

If you are still not getting these events, check the discussion thread for the .16 workaround.]

Looking for more opportunities to use your flagship? Need a little more variety in your events?

This mod adds space battles to the lists of events which can occur during a warp jump, similar to the shipboard battles with you and your companions. They should come up about as often in each of the three difficulty levels, though red paths will see them more often, as that set only had three events to begin with. Otherwise there is a roughly 10-20% chance of them spawning one of the several events per level*. You will encounter a variety of opponents with challenge ratings that scale with the route difficulty (the orange red route fights are tough**).

* A note on how random warp encounters work - they're not actually random. Well, they're a little random. Each route difficulty has its own event table. Within the table events begin the game with about a 3-5% chance of happening each. The first roll in your save file is a genuine random chance. However, when an event is triggered, that option goes to a 0% chance and every other event gets boosted slightly, and so on for every event you draw. So an event you have seen has a very low chance of recurring, but gets progressively higher and events you have not seen will have the highest likelihood of occurring, eventually becoming almost unavoidable. This type of selection algorithm is good because it eventually gives you every event (probably) and lowers the odds of you getting repeats over fairly long periods (except red routes, red routes only have 5 events even after I added some so they're weird). The thing about this mod is that it injects the new events into the existing table in the middle of that state, so depending how far you are into the game, and how many jumps you made, you may get a run of these then not see them again for a while, or you might  not see them for a fair few jumps at all. The optimal way to use the mod is to add it either at the start of the game or in act 2, but you can add it at any time. It's a bad idea to remove it though. keep a pre-mod save.

** Beware, the battles can be very hard early game. In order to make it easier to avoid them if you aren't ready but still need to take hard routes, I've made the avoid the fight option have no consequences.

# Skill Check Assistant mod for Warhammer 40K: Rogue Trader

Allows taking (rolling preset value) when doing skill checks.
Available options are: roll normally, take 50, take 33, take 25, take 10, take 1.
Settings are per individual skill.

By default everything is rolled normally.

### Added in 1.3.0

Option `If chosen "Take X" value is not low enough to succeed, try rolling check normally.`
Default: off   
This is for when you want to take X when X is enough, and try to roll if it's not. For playstyle where you don't want to reload for easy checks, but want to make harder ones a gamble and make use of things that allow rerolling (like Advanced Skill).


## Installation
1. Unpack archive directly into `%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\UnityModManager\` WITHOUT creating additional archive named folder.
2. After running the game, navigate to UMM mod settings (press Ctrl-F10) and set settings as you need.

Resulting structure of already existing UnityModManager folder should be as follows
- `SkillCheckAssistant` (folder)
	- `SkillCheckAssistant.dll`
	- `Info.info`

## How to build (for developers only)
1. Set up RoguePath environment variable to point to game folder
2. Restore nuget packages
3. Clean Solution.
4. Build (note that on build output is automatically copied to installation path).

Description:
# Warhammer 40K: Rogue Trader - SpeechMod
By [Osmodium](https://github.com/Osmodium)

## This mod is made for Warhammer 40K: Rogue Trader and introduces TTS (TextToSpeech) in most places.
Version: 1.2.0

---

As of now this is the support on each platform:
- **Windows**: ✅ Should work with the features implemented.
- **OSX**: ⚠️ Might work, let me know if there are any issues.
- **Linux**: ⛔ Not supported (this includes Steam Deck).

---

### 🚨 This mod contains no AI and no pre-baked voice files!🚨
The mod utilizes the internal Text-To-Speech (`SAPI`) functionality in **Windows**, or the `say` command on **OSX**.

**📢Works with all languages as long as you have a voice in that language installed.**

---

[How to unlock more voices in Windows 10/11](https://www.ghacks.net/2018/08/11/unlock-all-windows-10-tts-voices-system-wide-to-get-more-of-them/)

**How to use natural voices.**
Install this application: [NaturalVoiceSAPIAdapter](https://github.com/gexgd0419/NaturalVoiceSAPIAdapter)
Note: It seems to only support offline voices on Windows 11 and online voices seem to crash when they are being stopped during speech.
Disclaimer: I do **NOT** intend to support issues related to the NaturalVoicesSAPIAdapter application.

---

### How to install 📝

 1. Download the W40KSpeechMod mod file and unzip.
 2. Please note that the game comes with its own built in Unity Mod Manager so you do not need to install another one.
 3. Navigate to *%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\UnityModManager\\*
 4. Copy the *W40KSpeechMod* folder into the *UnityModManager* folder
 5. Launch Warhammer 40K: Rogue Trader, you may need to hit **ctrl+F10** to see the mod manager window.

---

### Known issues / limitations❗

*If you find issues or would like to request features, please use the issues tracker in GitHub [here](https://github.com/Osmodium/WH40KRTSpeechMod/issues)*

#### Limitations:
- No controller support (and probably never will have)
- Can't playback book event choices yet.

#### Todo:
- Still some work to do, see https://github.com/Osmodium/W40KRogueTraderSpeechMod/blob/main/Todo.txt for more info.

## How to use❓

#### 1) Dialog
When in dialog you can press the play button next to the left image to listen to the current block of dialog. If autoplay is enabled, you don't have to push the playbutton.

![Playbutton for the current dialog](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/18_DialogPlayButton.png)

#### 2) Dialog Answers
Also when in dialog, you can choose to have playbuttons for each of the dialog answers, and which color the hover effect should make the answer, so you know when you are selecting it or having it playback.

![Playbutton for each dialog answer](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/7_Dialog_Option_Playback_Hover_Color.png)

#### 3) Inspection Information
When inspecting items and links (through *right-click->Info* or just *right-click* for expanded tooltip) *hover* over the text and *left click*.

![Here the hover behaviour is set to underline the text, see the settings for more custumization](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/1_ExpandedTooltips.png)

#### 4) Journal Quest and Rumors text
In the journal, each of the bigger text blocks and important stuff can be played through the play button adjacent to the text. The text blocks without a playbutton can be played by hovering and left-clicking.

![Hover of quest-texts, and play button for titles](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/13_Jounal_Quest_Texts.png)
![Same goes for rumors](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/14_Journal_Rumors_Texts.png)

#### 5) Corpus Valancius (Encyclopedia)
In the Corpus Valancius the text blocks (defined by Owlcat) can be played by pressing the play button adjacent to the text. The rest of the text can be played by hovering and left-clicking.

![Playbuttons for each part and left-clicking on text for the rest](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/12_Encyclopedia_Corpus_Valancius_Texts.png)

#### 6) Book Event text
When encountering a book event, the text can be played by hovering the text part (it will apply the chosen hover effect) and left-clicking.
Historical text also supported.

![Book event text support](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/5_BookEvent_And_History.png)

#### 7) Messagebox text
The various pop-up boxes that eventually shows up throughout the game, can be played when hovered and left-clicked.

![Some texts might be so important that I decided to add support for them.](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/3_MessageBoxes.png)

#### 8) Tutorial Windows text
Both big and small tutorial windows text is supported and can be played by hovering and left-clicking.

![Tutorials can be helpful to learn more.](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/2_Tutorial_Small.png)

#### 9) Character biography
When inspecting a character, the story of that character is displayed both under *Summary* and under *Biography*, and are both supported by hovering and left-clicking.

![Character biography support](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/11_Biography_Texts.png)

#### 10) Character archetypes
Either when just inspecting a character or leveling up, the text for each of the parts are now supported by hovering and left-clicking.

![Showcasing the officers archetype](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/17_Character_Archetypes_Texts.png)

#### 11) Loading screen
When loading, the various texts can now be played by hovering and left-clicking. Note that the shortcut (keybind) doesn't work in loading screens.

![Bottom text](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/10_Loading_Screen_Texts.png)
![Character biography text](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/10_Loading_Screen_Character_Texts.png)

#### 12) Ship Upgrade screen
In the ship upgrade screen, different part of the ui texts can be played back by hovering and left-clicking.

![Flagship explanation text](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/15_Ship_Upgrade_Texts.png)

#### 13) Ship Posts screen
When assigning your crew different posts on the ship, the different texts can not be played back by hovering and left-clicking.

![Ship post of supreme commander text](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/16_Ship_Posts_Texts.png)

#### 14) Settings texts
When hovering a setting, the right part shows a description of the setting, this can now be played back by hovering and left-clicking.

![Menu text of the setting Bloodstains](https://dashvoid.com/speechmod/w40krt/9_Menu_Texts.png)

#### 15) Welcome message
In the main menu view, a welcome message is shown, this can be played back by hovering and left-clicking.

The different settings (available through *ctrl+f10* if not overridden in the UMM) for SpeechMod
- **Narrator Voice**: The settings for the voice used for either all or non-gender specific text in dialogs when *Use gender specific voices* is turned on.
	- *Nationality*: Just shows the selected voices nationality.
	- **Speech rate**: The speed of the voice the higher number, the faster the speech.
		- Windows: from -10 to 10 (relative speed from 0).
		- macOS: from 150 to 300 (words per minute).
	- Windows Only:
		- **Speech volume**: The volume of the voice from 0 to 100.
		- **Speech pitch**: The pitch of the voice from -10 to 10.
	-**Preview Voice**: Used to preview the settings of the voice.
- **Use protagonist specific voice**: Specify a voice to be used for every time the protagonist speaks.
- **Use gender specific voices**: Specify voices for female and male dialog parts. Each of the voices can be adjusted with rate, volume and pitch where available.
- Windows Only:
	- **Interrupt speech on play**: 2 settings: *Interrupt and play* or *Add to queue*, hope this speaks for itself.
- **Auto stop playback on loading**: When enabled, currently playing TTS will stop whenever the game loads (through a loading screen).
- **Auto play dialog**: When enabled, dialogs will be played automatically when theres no voice acted dialog.
- **Auto play ignores voiced dialog lines**: Only available when using auto play dialog. This option makes the auto play ignore when there is voiced dialog, remember to turn dialog off in the settings.
- **Show playback button of dialog answers**: When enabled, a play button will be added next to all dialog choices. These buttons playbacks the dialog answer, while not selecting it.
- **Include dialog answer number in playback**: When enabled and pressing a play button next to a dialog answer, the playback will lead with the choice number.
- **Color answer on hover**: This enables highlighting the dialog choice that corresponds to the play button that is hovered.
- **Playback barks**: When clicking on points of interests in the world, the small description is called a "Bark". Enabling this feature reads the bark aloud in the narrator voice. This also applies to character "banter" which is in the same style.
- **Only playback barks if silence**: When enabled, barks are only played if there is no other TTS playback currently playing. Can be useful with the next option.
- **Playback vicinity and cutscene triggered barks**: When enabled, all barks that are automatically played by either triggers or cutscenes, will be played. This can cause a lot of overlapping of playbacks. Hence the prior setting to only play when silence. Might look at some sort of system where automatically played barks, are low priority, compared to manually started playbacks.
- **Show notification on playback stop**: When this is enabled, a notification will show on the screen that the playback was stopped when the keybind for stopping is pressed. This keybinding can be set in the game menu under "Sound".
- **Color on hover**: This is used only for the text boxes when inspecting items, and colors the text the selected color when hovering the text box.
- **Font style on hover**: As above this is only used for text boxes, but lets you set the style of the font.
- **Phonetic Dictionary Reload**: Reloads the PhoneticDictionary.json into the game, to facilitate modificaton while playing.

### Motivation 💪
*Why did I create this mod?*
After having created the "same" mod for [Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous](https://www.nexusmods.com/pathfinderwrathoftherighteous/mods/241), I got requests of doing it for this game too, and since I also wanted to play it, I gratefully obliged :).

I have come to realize that I spend a lot of my energy through the day on various activities, so when I get to play a game I rarely have enough energy left over to focus on reading long passages of text. So I thought it nice if I could get a helping hand so I wouldn't miss out on the excellent stories and writing in text heavy games.

After I started creating this mod, I have thought to myself that if I struggle with this issue, imagine what people with genuine disabilities must go through and possibly miss out on, which motivated me even more to get this mod working and release it. I really hope that it will help and encourage more people to get as much out of the game as possible.

Description:
# Tabletop Miniature Bases A mod for Owlcat's Rogue Trader cRPG. Replaces the flat holographic disc in the inventory and character creation screens with a classic tabletop-style miniature base.

## Overview This mod adds a selection of tabletop-style miniature bases that replace the holographic disc that characters stand on in the inventory and character creation screens. Several different variants are provided, selectable via the mod manager. You can also optionally disable the green scanline VFX and floating servoskull in these screens. ## Installation This is an Owlmod, made using the Unity template supplied by Owlcat. In order to properly load custom assets, you ***must*** install the Unity Mod Manager-based mod [MicroPatches](https://github.com/microsoftenator2022/MicroPatches/releases) by microsoftenator2022. You can install it manually or via [ModFinder RT](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146). Use [ModFinder RT](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/146) to install this mod automagically. Alternatively, to install the mod manually, first make sure you have run the game at least once. Download the mod from the [releases section](https://github.com/DarthParametric/RT_Tabletop_Miniature_Bases_For_Inventory_Screen/releases/latest) or [Nexus](https://www.nexusmods.com/warhammer40kroguetrader/mods/406) and extract it into: `%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Owlcat Games\Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader\Modifications\` Each Owlmod needs to be in its own sub-folder in the Modifications folder. Afterwards, you need to edit OwlcatModificationManagerSettings.json in the base Warhammer 40000 Rogue Trader folder in a text editor (Notepad++ recommended). It should look something like this: ``` { "$id": "1", "SourceDirectories": [], "EnabledModifications": ["DPTabletopMiniatureBases"], "ActiveModifications": ["DPTabletopMiniatureBases"], "DisabledModifications": [] } ``` If you have other mods, list them in quotes separated by commas. For example: ``` "EnabledModifications": ["DPTabletopMiniatureBases", "ModName2", "ModName3"], "ActiveModifications": ["DPTabletopMiniatureBases", "ModName2", "ModName3"], ``` You can move individual mods from the ActiveModifications section to the DisabledModifications section if you want to disable them without physically removing them. ## User Settings You can configure the mod's settings via the [Owlcat Mod Manager](img/OMM_Settings_Screen.jpg) (Shift-F10 by default). Click on the Settings button next to the mod's name in the list, which will open its settings page. Alternatively, you can also open the [DLC and Mods Manager](img/DLC_Manager_Settings.jpg) on the lefthand side of the main menu, switch to the Mods tab, and scroll down until you find the mod's entry. There you can click on the Settings icon to open the mod's settings window directly. Here you can enable or disable base swapping, choose the type of base you want to use, and whether you want to disable the post-process effects such as the green scanlines, the distortion effect, and the floating servoskull in the background. Once you have changed the settings to your desired values, hit the Apply button at the bottom to save them. Your settings will be saved in a `DPTabletopMiniatureBases_Data.json` file in the Modifications folder. The settings apply universally across all saves. ## Known Issues The mod works when using a controller, but the in-game settings window is not available for the controller layout. Choosing the option to disable post-process effects will also disable the background image, leaving your character in a black void. This is unavoidable as they are all linked together in a single post-process object. The reflection probe in the scene does not capture dynamic objects (and trying to enable the option didn't work), so the character won't show up in any reflections on the glossy surfaces of the base. This is particularly apparent on the plain black base. The top surface looks kind of weird because of that. Larger characters, such as Ulfar and Glaito, automatically switch to using a larger diameter base. On rare occasions, equipping a weapon may cause the base to switch to the smaller one. I _think_ I have prevented this from re-occurring, but it may just be difficult to reproduce. Machine translations for the config screen text have been added. If anyone is willing to provide proper translations, let me know. ## Acknowledgements Many thanks to the modders on the Owlcat Discord, but particularly microsoftenator2022, Kurufinve, and ADDB for helping to coach me through my ineptitude in order to get the mod working. Thanks to Kurufinve for providing improvements to the Russian translation.
